about_the_game:
Where can I find the Outfits?

It will automatically be with your other outfits when you start the game!

About the Artbook

The official Strike Force Heroes Digital Artbook features high resolution artwork from both the remake as well as the original Flash game. Everything is hand drawn by Sky9's artist Mike Sleva and details comparisons between the characters, classes, weapons, cutscenes, and levels!
detailed_description:
HOW TO ACCESS THE ARTBOOK

To access your digital content, go to your Steam Library.
Right-Click on Strike Force Heroes in your Library.
Select Manage > Browse local files.
From here you will find the content named "Strike Force Heroes Digital Artbook".
